name: Fuyuta
source:
"For my sake, Yuzuki-san, I'll do my best!"

A boy so pure and loyal that you want to tease him. He suddenly appears and takes care of his surroundings. It's said that he's paying back the protagonist's grandmother for taking care of him before.

Because he wants to make the protagonist's wishes come true, he's usually made to cosplay and is sexually harassed. He loves honey, but hates bees and dogs.

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/aki01251/status/1590501899182432256]official bio[/url]]
